views.definition:
SELECT id,
    branch_id,
    work_start_date,
    work_end_date,
    open_at,
    close_at,
    created_at,
    status AS stored_status,
    registration_effective_status(open_at, close_at, statement_timestamp()) AS status
   FROM registration_periods p;

SELECT h.period_id,
    h.employee_id,
    h.status,
    h.errors,
    h.submitted_at,
    h.updated_at,
    COALESCE(h.sample_batch_id, legacy.id) AS sample_batch_id,
    h.sample_batch_id AS stored_sample_batch_id
   FROM registration_submissions h
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.id
           FROM audit_logs a
          WHERE a.entity_id = h.period_id AND a.action::text = 'TV2_TEST_SEED'::text AND a.change_source::text = 'SYSTEM'::text AND a.actor_id IS NULL AND (a.new_data ->> 'fixture'::text) = 'tv2-test-week-20261026-v1'::text AND (a.new_data ->> 'synthetic'::text) = 'true'::text AND (a.new_data -> 'employee_ids'::text) @> jsonb_build_array(h.employee_id) AND h.status::text = 'VALID'::text AND h.errors = '[]'::jsonb AND h.submitted_at = '2026-10-24 03:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND h.updated_at <= a.created_at
          ORDER BY a.created_at
         LIMIT 1) legacy ON h.sample_batch_id IS NULL;
